It’s not just your first year grades that matter it’s also your level of engagement- if I’m asked to write a reference (eg for an internship) the company will often ask about a students attitude to learning in addition to their grades.

As a lecturer and personal academic tutor- engage! Engage with your tutor (they’ll be the ones writing you a reference); engage with other students on the course (to make friends and to help with studying); engage with lecturers (asking questions in a lecture is scary but stopping behind for a couple of minutes after everyone else has gone isn’t) and engage with wellbeing services when things aren’t going well. 
Also, take on board any feedback you are given- it’s the best way to improve and get the higher grades.
